words.enDefinition: an advertisement for a place that is available to rent

examples.en: I found an apartment listing near campus with photos of every room.
examples.zh: 我找到一条学校附近的「房源信息」，每个房间都拍了照片。

examples.en: That apartment listing was posted three days ago, so ask if the place is still open.
examples.zh: 那条「房源信息」是三天前发的，先问问房子是不是还空着。

words.enDefinition: a posted offer to rent out a room or flat

examples.en: I replied to a rental listing this morning and the landlord emailed me back already.
examples.zh: 我上午回复了一条「出租信息」，房东已经回我邮件了。

examples.en: Read the rental listing carefully before you ask for a viewing.
examples.zh: 约看房之前，先仔细读一遍这条「出租信息」。

words.enDefinition: a website where landlords post places for rent

examples.en: This listing site lets you filter apartments by price and distance to campus.
examples.zh: 这个「房源平台」可以按价格和到学校的距离筛选公寓。

examples.en: Compare the same apartment on two listing sites before you book a viewing.
examples.zh: 约看房之前，先在两个「房源平台」上对比同一套公寓。

collocations: filter results on a listing site

words.enDefinition: a site with rental ads and housing advice

examples.en: The university housing website lists rooms that landlords rent to students.
examples.zh: 学校「租房网站」上列着房东租给学生的房间。

examples.en: I saved the housing website to my bookmarks so I can check new posts daily.
examples.zh: 我把这个「租房网站」收藏了，方便每天查看新帖。

words.enDefinition: a platform where tenants search for rental homes

examples.en: I set the rental website to email me whenever a studio comes on the market.
examples.zh: 我在「租房平台」上设置了提醒，一有单身公寓出租就发邮件给我。

examples.en: Read reviews of the rental website before you pay anyone anything.
examples.zh: 在给任何人付钱之前，先看看这个「租房平台」的评价。

collocations: create an account on a rental website

words.enDefinition: a rental ad published on the internet

examples.en: The online listing looked perfect, but the photos were all taken years ago.
examples.zh: 这条「网上房源」看着很完美，但照片全是好多年前拍的。

examples.en: Always visit in person because an online listing can hide problems.
examples.zh: 一定要实地看看，因为「网上房源」可能藏着问题。

words.enDefinition: a rental ad posted by someone dishonest

examples.en: The price seemed impossible, and it turned out to be a fake listing.
examples.zh: 那个价格低得离谱，结果是一条「虚假房源」。

examples.en: A fake listing usually asks you to send money before you see the room.
examples.zh: 「虚假房源」通常会让你在没看房之前就先转账。

words.enDefinition: a rental ad that has just been posted

examples.en: Check the site every evening because new listings in September go fast.
examples.zh: 每天晚上都刷刷网站，九月的「新房源」很快就没了。

examples.en: I set an alert so I see every new listing within minutes.
examples.zh: 我设了提醒，每条「新房源」几分钟内就能看到。

words.enDefinition: a notification when a matching rental is posted

examples.en: Set up a listing alert with your budget so good places reach you first.
examples.zh: 按你的预算设置一个「房源提醒」，好房子会第一时间推送给你。

examples.en: My listing alert woke me up at midnight because a room near campus opened.
examples.zh: 半夜「房源提醒」把我吵醒了，学校附近出了间空房。

words.enDefinition: bookmark a rental ad to look at again

examples.en: Save a listing right away because good rooms disappear within hours.
examples.zh: 看到合适的马上「收藏房源」，好房间几个小时就没了。

examples.en: I saved ten listings last night and messaged the three I liked best.
examples.zh: 我昨晚一共「收藏房源」十条，然后联系了最喜欢的那三家。

words.enDefinition: searching for an apartment to rent

examples.en: Apartment hunting in August is stressful because almost everything is taken.
examples.zh: 八月「找公寓」很熬人，因为差不多都租出去了。

examples.en: My advisor gave me some apartment hunting tips before I arrived.
examples.zh: 来之前，导师给了我一些「找公寓」的建议。

words.enDefinition: looking for a house or flat to rent

examples.en: We spent our whole weekend house hunting and saw six places.
examples.zh: 整个周末我们都在「找房子」，看了六处地方。

examples.en: Take photos during house hunting so you can compare the rooms later.
examples.zh: 「找房子」时多拍些照片，方便之后对比各个房间。

words.enDefinition: the supply and prices of rental homes in an area

examples.en: The rental market gets crazy every September when students arrive.
examples.zh: 每年九月学生报到，「租房市场」就疯狂起来。

examples.en: Compare prices across the city because the rental market varies by neighborhood.
examples.zh: 多比较全城的价格，不同社区的「租房市场」差别很大。

words.enDefinition: narrow search results by setting a rent range

examples.en: Filter by price first, then sort the results by distance to campus.
examples.zh: 先「按价格筛选」，再按离学校的远近排序。

examples.en: The site lets you filter by price so you never see apartments over your budget.
examples.zh: 网站支持「按价格筛选」，超预算的公寓根本不会出现。

words.enDefinition: a small list of the best options you found

examples.en: After two weeks of searching I finally narrowed it down to a shortlist of three.
examples.zh: 找了两周后，我最终把范围缩小到一份只有三个房间的「候选清单」。

examples.en: Send your shortlist to a friend and ask which apartment she would pick.
examples.zh: 把「候选清单」发给朋友，问问她会选哪套公寓。

words.enDefinition: look at several rental ads side by side

examples.en: Compare listings for a week before you visit anything in person.
examples.zh: 实地看房之前，先花一周时间「对比房源」。

examples.en: It helps to compare listings in a spreadsheet with price, commute, and bills.
examples.zh: 用表格「对比房源」很有用，可以记下价格、通勤和账单。

words.enDefinition: a sign or ad saying a place is available to rent

examples.en: I spotted a flat to let near the station and called the number right away.
examples.zh: 我在车站附近看到一套「房屋招租」的公寓，立刻拨了上面的电话。

examples.en: In Britain you often see rooms to let advertised in corner shop windows.
examples.zh: 在英国，街角小店的橱窗里常贴着「房屋招租」的小广告。

words.enDefinition: one small room combining bed, kitchen, and living space

examples.en: A studio apartment is cheaper, but you cook and sleep in the same room.
examples.zh: 「单身公寓」便宜一些，但做饭和睡觉都在同一个房间。

examples.en: She rents a studio apartment ten minutes from the engineering building.
examples.zh: 她租了一间离工学院大楼十分钟的「单身公寓」。

words.enDefinition: an apartment with one separate bedroom plus a living area

examples.en: Sharing a one-bedroom apartment with a friend saves a lot of rent.
examples.zh: 和朋友合租一套「一室公寓」能省下不少房租。

examples.en: The one-bedroom apartment is small, but the kitchen is surprisingly modern.
examples.zh: 这套「一室公寓」不大，厨房却出奇地新。

words.enDefinition: an apartment with two bedrooms and a shared living room

examples.en: Four of us looked at a two-bedroom apartment and agreed it was too crowded.
examples.zh: 我们四个人看了一套「两室公寓」，都觉得太挤了。

examples.en: A two-bedroom apartment near the lake rents for six hundred a month each.
examples.zh: 湖边那套「两室公寓」每人每月房租六百。

words.enDefinition: an apartment where tenants share the kitchen and bathroom

examples.en: In a shared apartment you get your own bedroom but share the kitchen.
examples.zh: 住「合租公寓」有自己的卧室，但厨房是共用的。

examples.en: My shared apartment has three flatmates from Korea, Brazil, and Germany.
examples.zh: 我的「合租公寓」里有三个室友，分别来自韩国、巴西和德国。

words.enDefinition: one bedroom that two or more people sleep in

examples.en: A shared room halves the rent, but bring earplugs and a sleep mask.
examples.zh: 住「合住房间」房租减半，但要带上耳塞和眼罩。

examples.en: The ad offers a shared room in a flat five minutes from campus.
examples.zh: 广告上说有一间「合住房间」，离学校五分钟。

words.enDefinition: a bedroom in a shared flat that only you use

examples.en: A private room in a shared flat costs two hundred more than a shared one.
examples.zh: 合租公寓里的「独立房间」比合住房间贵两百。

examples.en: I need a private room because I take late calls for my group project.
examples.zh: 我需要一个「独立房间」，因为小组作业经常要开晚上的电话会。

collocations: private room in a shared flat

words.enDefinition: an extra bedroom not currently being used

examples.en: Our flat has a spare room, so we posted an ad for a third flatmate.
examples.zh: 我们公寓有个「空余房间」，所以发帖招第三个室友。

examples.en: The landlord turned the spare room into storage, which annoyed the tenants.
examples.zh: 房东把「空余房间」改成了储物间，房客们很不高兴。

collocations: turn the spare room into a study

words.enDefinition: a rental that comes with bed, desk, and sofa included

examples.en: As an international student I chose a furnished apartment to avoid buying furniture.
examples.zh: 作为国际学生，我选了「带家具公寓」，省得自己买家具。

examples.en: This furnished apartment includes a bed, desk, wardrobe, and even a microwave.
examples.zh: 这套「带家具公寓」配了床、书桌、衣柜，连微波炉都有。

words.enDefinition: a rental with no furniture, so you buy your own

examples.en: The unfurnished apartment is two hundred cheaper, but beds and desks cost a lot.
examples.zh: 「不带家具公寓」便宜两百，但床和书桌花销不小。

examples.en: Most local landlords rent out unfurnished apartments, so plan a furniture budget.
examples.zh: 当地房东大多出租「不带家具公寓」，所以要预留买家具的预算。

collocations: buy furniture for an unfurnished apartment

words.enDefinition: equipped with all the main furniture you need

examples.en: The listing says the flat comes fully furnished with bedding and lamps.
examples.zh: 房源说这套公寓「家具齐全」，连床上用品和台灯都有。

examples.en: Our room was not fully furnished, so we bought a desk secondhand.
examples.zh: 我们的房间并不「家具齐全」，只好二手买了张书桌。

words.enDefinition: having some basic furniture but not everything

examples.en: The flat is partially furnished, so we still need a sofa and curtains.
examples.zh: 这套公寓只是「部分带家具」，我们还得买沙发和窗帘。

examples.en: Partially furnished rooms suit students who already have a desk and chair.
examples.zh: 「部分带家具」的房间适合已经有桌椅的学生。

words.enDefinition: housing built or reserved mainly for students

examples.en: Private student housing is pricier than dorms but includes cleaning.
examples.zh: 私立「学生公寓」比宿舍贵，但包含保洁。

examples.en: Ask the international office whether student housing is guaranteed for first years.
examples.zh: 问问国际学生办公室，第一年是否保证有「学生公寓」。

words.enDefinition: accommodation located away from the university campus

examples.en: Two students in my seminar started looking for off-campus housing in February.
examples.zh: 跟我上同一门研讨课的两位同学二月份开始找「校外住房」。

examples.en: The housing office publishes an off-campus housing list with vetted landlords.
examples.zh: 住房办公室发布了经过审核房东的「校外住房」清单。

words.enDefinition: accommodation provided or managed by a university

examples.en: I applied for university housing before I started looking at rooms in town.
examples.zh: 在市区找房间之前，我先申请了「学校提供的住宿」。

examples.en: Our university housing included heating, so I could estimate my expenses for the term.
examples.zh: 「学校提供的住宿」包含供暖，所以我能估算这学期的开销。

words.enDefinition: an individual owner who rents out property directly

examples.en: Renting from a private landlord often means more flexible move-in dates.
examples.zh: 跟「私人房东」租房，入住日期往往更灵活。

examples.en: Our private landlord fixes things slowly, so report problems in writing.
examples.zh: 我们的「私人房东」修东西很慢，报修一定要留书面记录。

words.enDefinition: the person who handles a building's rentals and repairs

examples.en: The property manager showed us the unit and answered our questions about parking.
examples.zh: 「物业经理」带我们看了房间，还解答了停车位的问题。

examples.en: Send maintenance requests to the property manager, not to the owner directly.
examples.zh: 维修请求要发给「物业经理」，别直接找房东本人。

words.enDefinition: a place rented out again by its current tenant

examples.en: I found a cheap sublet for July and August near the main library.
examples.zh: 我在主图书馆附近找到一处七八月的便宜「转租房源」。

examples.en: The sublet ends in December, so ask what happens to the deposit then.
examples.zh: 这处「转租房源」十二月到期，问问到时候押金怎么处理。

words.enDefinition: someone who rents a property from an existing tenant

examples.en: Our lease says the landlord needs to approve a subtenant before anyone moves in.
examples.zh: 我们的租约写明，「转租租客」入住前得先获房东同意。

examples.en: As a subtenant in this flat, I pay rent directly to the main tenant.
examples.zh: 作为这套公寓的「转租租客」，我直接把房租付给主租客。

words.enDefinition: rent your leased place to someone else temporarily

examples.en: My lease says I need written consent before I can sublease the room.
examples.zh: 我的租约写明，我需要先得到书面同意，才可以「转租」房间。

examples.en: I plan to sublease my apartment over the internship and keep my lease.
examples.zh: 实习期间我打算把公寓「转租」出去，自己的租约继续保留。

collocations: sublease my room for the summer

words.enDefinition: a post saying you are looking for a room

examples.en: She posted a room wanted ad with her budget and preferred move-in date.
examples.zh: 她发了一条「求租广告」，写明了预算和期望入住日期。

examples.en: Reply to the room wanted ad quickly because good tenants get snapped up.
examples.zh: 看到「求租广告」要尽快回复，好租客很抢手。

collocations: reply to a room wanted ad
room wanted ad in the group chat

words.enDefinition: a post advertising an opening for a new roommate

examples.en: There is a roommate wanted post on the class forum for a September move-in.
examples.zh: 班级论坛上有一条九月入住的「招室友」帖子。

examples.en: The roommate wanted ad says bills are split four ways.
examples.zh: 那条「招室友」广告写着账单四人平摊。

words.enDefinition: searching for someone to share your rented home

examples.en: My post says I am looking for a roommate to share a two-bedroom flat.
examples.zh: 我的帖子写着「找室友」，一起合租两居室。

examples.en: I have been looking for a roommate since Maya moved back home.
examples.zh: 自从玛雅搬回家之后，我一直在「找室友」。

words.enDefinition: a chat to see if you suit living together

examples.en: Treat the roommate interview like a casual chat, not a job interview.
examples.zh: 「室友面谈」就当闲聊，不用搞成求职面试。

examples.en: During the roommate interview, ask how they feel about overnight guests.
examples.zh: 「室友面谈」时问问他们对留宿客人是什么态度。

words.enDefinition: spend time with future flatmates before agreeing

examples.en: Always meet the roommates before signing because chemistry matters more than rent.
examples.zh: 签约前一定要「和室友见面」，合不合得来比房租更重要。

examples.en: Can I meet the roommates this Thursday evening after my seminar?
examples.zh: 我可以周四讨论课之后「和室友见面」吗？

words.enDefinition: a friend who stays at your place for the night

examples.en: Ask about the overnight guest rule before you sign anything.
examples.zh: 签约之前先问清楚「留宿客人」的规定。

examples.en: My roommate said overnight guests are fine as long as we get advance notice.
examples.zh: 室友说「留宿客人」没问题，只要提前打个招呼。

words.enDefinition: the house rules about friends staying or visiting

examples.en: The guest policy limits each of us to two weekend nights a month.
examples.zh: 「访客规定」限制我们每人每月最多留宿客人两个周末晚上。

examples.en: A strict guest policy is not a dealbreaker if the rent is right.
examples.zh: 只要房租合适，「访客规定」严一点也能接受。

words.enDefinition: divide the rent among the people living together

examples.en: We split the rent evenly even though my room is slightly bigger.
examples.zh: 虽然我的房间稍大一点，我们还是平均「分摊房租」。

examples.en: Splitting the rent three ways brings each share down to four hundred.
examples.zh: 「分摊房租」三份之后，每人只要四百。

collocations: split the rent by room size
agree on how to split the rent

words.enDefinition: shared spaces like the kitchen and living room

examples.en: Everyone cleans the common areas on a rota every Sunday.
examples.zh: 每周日大家按轮值表打扫「公共区域」。

examples.en: Keep the common area tidy or the landlord may blame all of us.
examples.zh: 「公共区域」要保持整洁，不然房东会把账算到我们所有人头上。

words.enDefinition: a formal request for university or housing office accommodation

examples.en: The housing application for next year opens in early February.
examples.zh: 明年的「住宿申请」二月初开放。

examples.en: Attach your offer letter before you submit the housing application.
examples.zh: 提交「住宿申请」之前，记得附上录取信。

words.enDefinition: a form a landlord uses to choose a tenant

examples.en: The landlord sent us a rental application within an hour of the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房后一小时内，房东就把「租房申请」发给了我们。

examples.en: A complete rental application needs ID, references, and proof of income.
examples.zh: 一份完整的「租房申请」需要证件、推荐人和收入证明。

words.enDefinition: a small charge to process your rental application

examples.en: The application fee is forty dollars and it is not refundable.
examples.zh: 「租房申请费」是四十美元，而且不予退还。

examples.en: Some landlords waive the application fee if you view the unit first.
examples.zh: 有些房东只要你先看过房，就免收「租房申请费」。

words.enDefinition: where your rental application stands in the process

examples.en: I emailed the agent twice to check my application status.
examples.zh: 我发了两封邮件询问「申请进度」。

examples.en: The application status changed to approved this morning, so we got the flat.
examples.zh: 今天早上「申请进度」变成了已通过，房子拿到手了。

words.enDefinition: the landlord has accepted your rental application

examples.en: My application was approved the same evening, so I signed the next morning.
examples.zh: 我的「申请通过」当晚就收到通知，第二天上午就去签了约。

examples.en: Two other people applied, so I felt lucky my application got approved.
examples.zh: 还有两个人也在申请，我的「申请通过」真是运气好。

words.enDefinition: send in your rental form for consideration

examples.en: Submit an application online the same day you view the flat.
examples.zh: 看完房的当天就在网上「提交申请」。

examples.en: We submitted an application for both rooms to double our chances.
examples.zh: 两间房我们都「提交申请」，双保险机会更大。

words.enDefinition: checks a landlord runs before accepting a tenant

examples.en: Tenant screening usually covers ID, income, and your rental history.
examples.zh: 「租客筛查」通常包括身份、收入和租房历史。

examples.en: The tenant screening fee added another thirty dollars to my moving costs.
examples.zh: 「租客筛查」费又让我的搬家开销多了三十美元。

words.enDefinition: verification of your references before you rent

examples.en: The referencing check took five working days because my old landlord replied late.
examples.zh: 「租房背景审查」花了五个工作日，因为前房东回复太慢。

examples.en: Fail the referencing check and the letting agent will offer the flat to someone else.
examples.zh: 要是没通过「租房背景审查」，中介就会把房子给别人。

words.enDefinition: a previous landlord's opinion of you as a tenant

examples.en: My landlord in Vancouver sent a landlord reference saying I always paid on time.
examples.zh: 温哥华的房东给我写了封「房东推荐信」，说我从没拖欠过房租。

examples.en: A missing landlord reference slows down the whole referencing process.
examples.zh: 少了「房东推荐信」，整个审查流程都会被拖慢。

words.enDefinition: your record of past rentals and payments

examples.en: A clean rental history matters more to agents than your major.
examples.zh: 对中介来说，良好的「租房记录」比你的专业更重要。

examples.en: As a first-time renter my rental history is empty, so I added a guarantor.
examples.zh: 我第一次租房，「租房记录」是空白，所以加了担保人。

words.enDefinition: someone who promises to pay your rent if you cannot

examples.en: Most international students ask a parent to act as guarantor.
examples.zh: 大多数国际学生请父母担任「担保人」。

examples.en: Without a UK guarantor we had to pay six months of rent upfront.
examples.zh: 因为没有英国的「担保人」，我们只好预付了半年房租。

words.enDefinition: a person who signs the rental agreement with you

examples.en: My uncle in Chicago agreed to act as my co-signer.
examples.zh: 我在芝加哥的舅舅同意当我的「共同签约人」。

examples.en: The agent asked for a co-signer because my income does not meet the rule.
examples.zh: 因为收入不达标，中介要求我找一位「共同签约人」。

words.enDefinition: documents showing you earn enough to pay the rent

examples.en: Bring proof of income or three months of bank statements to the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时带上「收入证明」或三个月的银行流水。

examples.en: Scholarship letters count as proof of income for many student lets.
examples.zh: 对很多学生租房来说，奖学金证明也可以当作「收入证明」。

words.enDefinition: a letter from an employer confirming your job

examples.en: Part-time workers may need proof of employment plus a guarantor.
examples.zh: 兼职工作者可能需要「在职证明」，外加一个担保人。

examples.en: My campus job supervisor wrote proof of employment for my rental file.
examples.zh: 校内工作的主管为我的租房材料开具了「在职证明」。

words.enDefinition: a fixed time arranged to see a rental unit

examples.en: My viewing appointment is at four on Friday, right after my lab.
examples.zh: 我的「看房预约」在周五下午四点，实验课刚结束。

examples.en: Confirm the viewing appointment by email in case the address changed.
examples.zh: 用邮件确认一下「看房预约」，以防地址有变。

words.enDefinition: arrange a time to visit a rental in person

examples.en: Book a viewing immediately because this studio will not last the week.
examples.zh: 赶紧「预约看房」，这套单身公寓撑不过这个星期。

examples.en: You can book a viewing directly on the site and pick a time slot.
examples.zh: 你可以直接在网站上「预约看房」，挑选时间段。

words.enDefinition: visiting the unit physically before deciding

examples.en: Never send money before an in-person viewing, no matter how urgent the ad sounds.
examples.zh: 无论广告多急人，「实地看房」之前都不要打钱。

examples.en: The agent offers video tours, but I still want an in-person viewing.
examples.zh: 中介可以视频带看，但我还是想要「实地看房」。

words.enDefinition: seeing the unit live on a call with the agent

examples.en: We arranged a video viewing because I could not visit the apartment before classes began.
examples.zh: 因为开课前没法实地去公寓，我们安排了一次「视频看房」。

examples.en: During the video viewing, I asked the agent to show the nearest window to the desk.
examples.zh: 「视频看房」时，我请中介给我看看离书桌最近的那扇窗。

words.enDefinition: an interactive online view used to explore a property

examples.en: I used the virtual tour to look around the living room before booking a viewing.
examples.zh: 预约看房前，我用「虚拟看房」功能在网上浏览了客厅。

examples.en: A virtual tour cannot show street noise, so talk to the current tenant too.
examples.zh: 「虚拟看房」听不到街道噪音，最好再问问现在的租客。

words.enDefinition: a set time when anyone can visit the rental

examples.en: The landlord holds an open house on Sunday afternoon for the ground-floor unit.
examples.zh: 房东周日下午为底层那套房子办「看房开放日」。

examples.en: At the open house, arrive early because serious renters come first.
examples.zh: 「看房开放日」要早点到，认真租房的人都赶早。

words.enDefinition: a guided walk through the apartment for renters

examples.en: The apartment tour lasted ten minutes because two groups were waiting outside.
examples.zh: 这次「公寓带看」只有十分钟，外面还有两组人在排队。

examples.en: During the apartment tour, open the taps and check the wardrobe depth.
examples.zh: 「公寓带看」时，拧开水龙头，量一量衣柜的深度。

words.enDefinition: the rent the landlord asks for in the listing

examples.en: The asking rent is one thousand two hundred, bills not included.
examples.zh: 「标价租金」一千二，不含账单。

examples.en: They dropped the asking rent by fifty after the flat sat empty for a month.
examples.zh: 房子空了一个月后，房东把「标价租金」降了五十。

words.enDefinition: rent noticeably cheaper than similar local homes

examples.en: A room below market rent usually means a catch, so read the ad twice.
examples.zh: 「低于市价的租金」往往有猫腻，广告要读两遍。

examples.en: University-owned flats are often below market rent for graduate students.
examples.zh: 学校名下公寓的租金对研究生来说通常「低于市价」。

words.enDefinition: a reduction in the advertised rent

examples.en: The listing shows a price drop of one hundred after three weeks on the market.
examples.zh: 挂了三周之后，房源显示「房租降价」一百。

examples.en: I saved the listing to get an email whenever there is a price drop.
examples.zh: 我收藏了那条房源，一有「房租降价」就发邮件提醒我。

words.enDefinition: try to agree a lower rent with the landlord

examples.en: You can negotiate the rent if you offer a twelve-month lease.
examples.zh: 如果你愿意签十二个月租约，可以试着「协商房租」。

examples.en: Students rarely negotiate the rent, but asking politely sometimes works.
examples.zh: 学生很少「协商房租」，但礼貌地开口有时真管用。

collocations: negotiate the rent with the landlord

words.enDefinition: the rent covers heating with no extra charge

examples.en: Choose the room with heat included because it saves about sixty a month in winter.
examples.zh: 选那间「包暖气」的房间吧，冬天每月能省六十左右。

examples.en: The listing says heat included, so confirm what happens in February.
examples.zh: 房源写着「包暖气」，但二月份的情况还是要确认一下。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing the layout of the unit

examples.en: The floor plan shows the bedroom is beside the kitchen, not the street.
examples.zh: 「户型图」显示卧室紧挨厨房，并不临街。

examples.en: Compare the floor plan with the photos because listings sometimes stretch rooms.
examples.zh: 把「户型图」和照片对照一下，房源有时会把房间画大。

words.enDefinition: daylight that comes in through the windows

examples.en: I study at home, so I need a desk corner with natural light.
examples.zh: 我在家自习，所以书桌那角一定要有「自然采光」。

examples.en: Tall buildings across the street block most natural light in our living room.
examples.zh: 街对面的大楼挡住了我们客厅的大部分「自然采光」。

words.enDefinition: facing towards the south

examples.en: The south-facing bedroom overlooks the garden, while the kitchen faces the street.
examples.zh: 「朝南」的卧室俯瞰花园，厨房则面向街道。

examples.en: Ask which rooms are south-facing before you pay a deposit.
examples.zh: 交押金之前先问清楚哪些房间「朝南」。

words.enDefinition: a bathroom used only by you, not shared

examples.en: I chose a room with a private bathroom because I wanted more privacy.
examples.zh: 我选了带「独立卫浴」的房间，因为想要多一点隐私。

examples.en: The ad promises a private bathroom, though the photos only show a sink.
examples.zh: 广告说有「独立卫浴」，可照片里只拍到个洗手池。

words.enDefinition: a kitchen that everyone in the flat uses

examples.en: Six tenants use one shared kitchen, so Sunday nights get crowded.
examples.zh: 六个租客合用这间「共用厨房」，周日晚上特别挤。

examples.en: Label your food in the shared kitchen or it disappears fast.
examples.zh: 「共用厨房」里的食物要写上名字，不然很快就没了。

words.enDefinition: a bathroom that several tenants take turns using

examples.en: With a shared bathroom, set an alarm or you will be late.
examples.zh: 用「共用卫浴」就得定闹钟，不然上课要迟到。

examples.en: The shared bathroom is cleaned weekly, but bring your own mat.
examples.zh: 「共用卫浴」每周有人打扫，但防滑垫要自己带。

words.enDefinition: the day you start living in the rental

examples.en: My lease starts June first, but the move-in date is negotiable.
examples.zh: 租约六月一号生效，不过「入住日期」可以商量。

examples.en: Set the move-in date at least a week before orientation week.
examples.zh: 「入住日期」最好定在迎新周前一个星期。

words.enDefinition: the first day the landlord allows you to move in

examples.en: The earliest move-in date is August 25, which suits my visa interview.
examples.zh: 「最早入住日期」是八月二十五号，正好赶在我办签证之后。

examples.en: Email the agent to ask whether the earliest move-in date can slip a week.
examples.zh: 发邮件问问中介，「最早入住日期」能不能往后推一周。

collocations: ask about the earliest move-in date

words.enDefinition: persuade the landlord to change when you move in

examples.en: I negotiated the move-in date to September 1 so I do not pay for August.
examples.zh: 我跟房东「协商入住日期」，最后定在九月一号，省下了八月的房租。

examples.en: Ask to negotiate the move-in date before you sign, not after.
examples.zh: 签之前就「协商入住日期」，别等签完再谈。

collocations: negotiate the move-in date with the landlord
negotiate the move-in date before signing

words.enDefinition: not yet rented and open to offers

examples.en: I messaged the landlord to ask if the studio is still available.
examples.zh: 我给房东发了消息，问那间单身公寓是不是「还没租出去」。

examples.en: The listing says still available, but agents often forget to update it.
examples.zh: 房源上写着「还没租出去」，不过中介经常忘记更新。

collocations: ask if it is still available

words.enDefinition: taken by another tenant and no longer open

examples.en: By the time I called, the flat was already rented to a nursing student.
examples.zh: 等我打电话过去，那套公寓「已租出」，租给了护理系的学生。

examples.en: Good places near campus are already rented by June, so start early.
examples.zh: 学校附近的好房子六月就「已租出」，一定要趁早。

collocations: find out it is already rented

words.enDefinition: a rental for a few weeks or months only

examples.en: Book a short-term rental for your first month while you search properly.
examples.zh: 第一个月先订个「短租」，再慢慢认真找房。

examples.en: A short-term rental near campus costs more per week but buys you time.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「短租」每周贵一些，但能为你争取时间。

words.enDefinition: a rental meant to last a year or more

examples.en: Landlords prefer a long-term rental because it avoids empty months.
examples.zh: 房东更喜欢「长租」，因为不用愁空置的月份。

examples.en: Sign a long-term rental only after you have walked the neighborhood at night.
examples.zh: 晚上在社区走过一遍之后，再签「长租」也不迟。

words.enDefinition: a short-stay place while you find something permanent

examples.en: The international office helped me arrange temporary housing for my first fortnight.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室帮我安排了头两周的「临时住处」。

examples.en: Do not sign a year lease just to escape temporary housing.
examples.zh: 别为了摆脱「临时住处」就草草签下一年的租约。

words.enDefinition: the university office that helps students find housing

examples.en: The housing office keeps a list of landlords who rent to students.
examples.zh: 「住房办公室」有一份愿意租给学生的房东名单。

examples.en: Take your scam story to the housing office so they can warn others.
examples.zh: 把你遇到的骗局告诉「住房办公室」，让他们提醒其他同学。

words.enDefinition: how long it takes to travel from home to campus

examples.en: Cheap rent means nothing if the commute time reaches an hour each way.
examples.zh: 如果「通勤时间」单程要一小时，房租再便宜也没意义。

examples.en: Google Maps estimates my commute time at twenty minutes by bike.
examples.zh: 谷歌地图估算我的「通勤时间」骑车是二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: a quick, easy journey from home to campus

examples.en: I pay two hundred extra for a short commute and never regret it.
examples.zh: 为了「短通勤」我多付两百，从不后悔。

examples.en: A short commute means I can go home for lunch between lectures.
examples.zh: 「短通勤」意味着课间能回家吃个午饭。

words.enDefinition: an area generally regarded as safe for residents

examples.en: After months of walking home from evening classes, I could tell it was a safe neighborhood.
examples.zh: 连续几个月晚课后步行回家，我感觉自己住在一个「治安好的社区」。

examples.en: We asked local students what they meant when they called it a safe neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我们问了本地学生，他们说这里是「治安好的社区」具体指什么。

words.enDefinition: an area where shops and classes are on foot

examples.en: A walkable neighborhood saves me bus fares even if rent is higher.
examples.zh: 就算房租贵点，「适合步行的社区」也能帮我省下车费。

examples.en: We chose the walkable neighborhood so evening grocery runs feel safe.
examples.zh: 我们选了「适合步行的社区」，晚上去买菜也放心。

words.enDefinition: how safe an area is, especially after dark

examples.en: Neighborhood safety is my first question whenever an agent offers a bargain.
examples.zh: 中介一报低价，我第一个问题就是「社区治安」。

examples.en: The campus police page shares tips on researching neighborhood safety.
examples.zh: 校园警察网页上介绍了调查「社区治安」的方法。

words.enDefinition: a measure of reported crimes in an area over time

examples.en: The crime rate varied across the areas where my classmates were looking for a flat.
examples.zh: 我同学找房的几个区域，「犯罪率」各不相同。

examples.en: A low crime rate matters more to my parents than a gym in the building.
examples.zh: 比起楼里的健身房，我父母更看重「犯罪率」低。

words.enDefinition: comments from residents about living in an area

examples.en: One neighborhood review warned that the recycling truck arrives at six.
examples.zh: 有条「社区评价」提醒，垃圾车早上六点就来。

examples.en: Read a few neighborhood reviews before you trust the listing photos.
examples.zh: 先读几条「社区评价」，再决定信不信房源照片。

words.enDefinition: a rental scene where many tenants chase few homes

examples.en: September is a competitive market, so applications go out the same day.
examples.zh: 九月就是「竞争激烈的市场」，看中当天就得交申请。

examples.en: In a competitive market, a complete application folder makes you stand out.
examples.zh: 在「竞争激烈的市场」里，材料齐全的申请最占优势。

words.enDefinition: move quickly before someone else takes the place

examples.en: Act fast when a decent room appears under eight hundred.
examples.zh: 看到八百以下还像样的房间，就要「赶紧行动」。

examples.en: We had to act fast, so we booked the viewing for the same evening.
examples.zh: 我们必须「赶紧行动」，当晚就约了看房。

collocations: act fast on a good listing
act fast before it is gone

words.enDefinition: a second choice kept ready in case plans fail

examples.en: Keep a backup option in case your first application falls through.
examples.zh: 留一个「备选方案」，以防第一份申请黄了。

examples.en: Our backup option was a pricier flat two subway stops further out.
examples.zh: 我们的「备选方案」是远两站地铁但更贵的一套公寓。

words.enDefinition: a rushed housing search just before term starts

examples.en: A last-minute search in August left me choosing between two awful rooms.
examples.zh: 八月的「临时找房」让我只能在两个糟糕的房间之间挑。

examples.en: Avoid a last-minute search by listing your requirements before you land.
examples.zh: 落地前先把需求列清楚，避免「临时找房」。

words.enDefinition: begin looking for housing months ahead of term

examples.en: Start searching early because international students need time for video viewings.
examples.zh: 要「提早找房」，国际学生还得留出视频看房的时间。

examples.en: My roommate started searching early and got the cheapest room on our street.
examples.zh: 我室友因为「提早找房」，拿到了我们街上最便宜的一间。

words.enDefinition: the months when everyone is looking for housing

examples.en: August is the peak season here, so landlords ignore discount requests.
examples.zh: 这里的八月是「租房旺季」，房东根本不理砍价请求。

examples.en: Apply in June, before peak season pushes prices up by a fifth.
examples.zh: 六月就申请，赶在「租房旺季」把价格推高两成之前。

words.enDefinition: a trick that steals money from apartment seekers

examples.en: The classic rental scam asks for a deposit before you ever see the room.
examples.zh: 典型的「租房骗局」会让你还没看房就先交押金。

examples.en: Our international student group chats warn members about rental scams every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，留学生群都会提醒大家小心「租房骗局」。

words.enDefinition: a warning sign that something is dishonest

examples.en: A landlord who refuses any video call is a huge red flag.
examples.zh: 房东连视频看房都不肯，这是很大的「危险信号」。

examples.en: Ignore the grammar mistakes, but never ignore a red flag about money.
examples.zh: 错别字可以忽略，但涉及钱的「危险信号」绝不能忽视。

collocations: red flag when they rush you

words.enDefinition: suspiciously perfect, usually hiding a trick

examples.en: A downtown one-bedroom for three hundred a month is too good to be true.
examples.zh: 市中心一居室月租只要三百？这种「好得难以置信」的价位多半有诈。

examples.en: That furnished flat near the beach seemed too good to be true, and it was.
examples.zh: 那套海滩边的带家具公寓「好得难以置信」，事实证明果然有诈。

collocations: rent seems too good to be true
deal too good to be true
if it seems too good to be true

words.enDefinition: an impostor who pretends to own the rental

examples.en: A fake landlord cannot meet you at the address because the flat is not his.
examples.zh: 「假房东」没法带你去房子那里，因为房子根本不是他的。

examples.en: The fake landlord claimed to be abroad and pushed for a wire transfer.
examples.zh: 「假房东」谎称人在国外，催我马上电汇。

words.enDefinition: images that make the unit look better than it is

examples.en: The bedroom looked double in the ad, classic misleading photos from a wide lens.
examples.zh: 广告里卧室显得大了一倍，典型的广角「失真照片」。

examples.en: Report misleading photos so the platform can warn future renters.
examples.zh: 遇到「失真照片」要举报，让平台提醒后来的租客。

words.enDefinition: old pictures that no longer match the unit

examples.en: The kitchen in the outdated photos still had the old oven and no stains.
examples.zh: 「过时照片」里的厨房还是旧烤箱，也没有油渍。

examples.en: Ask the agent for fresh pictures if the listing only has outdated photos.
examples.zh: 如果房源用的都是「过时照片」，就让中介拍几张新的。

words.enDefinition: the images attached to a rental advertisement

examples.en: Zoom into the listing photos to spot damp corners and old sockets.
examples.zh: 把「房源照片」放大看，找出潮湿的角落和老化的插座。

examples.en: She sent photos of the unit taken that morning, not stock listing photos.
examples.zh: 她发来的是当天早上拍的房间实照，不是库存的「房源照片」。

words.enDefinition: send money before you have seen the place

examples.en: I refused to pay before viewing when the advertiser would not answer basic questions.
examples.zh: 发布广告的人连基本问题都不回答，我拒绝「没看房就付钱」。

examples.en: The scammer invented an emergency and begged me to pay before viewing.
examples.zh: 骗子编了个急事，求我「没看房就付钱」。

words.enDefinition: check that a rental advertisement and its details are genuine

examples.en: I tried to verify the listing by checking whether the agency advertised it too.
examples.zh: 我查了中介有没有发布同一则广告，想「核实房源」。

examples.en: I verify the listing by asking for the landlord's ownership documents.
examples.zh: 我让房东出示产权文件来「核实房源」。

collocations: verify the listing on a map
verify the listing with the agent

words.enDefinition: offered to tenants, usually on a sign or ad

examples.en: There is a for rent sign on the corner house two blocks from the gym.
examples.zh: 离健身房两个街区的那栋房子门口挂着「房屋出租」。

examples.en: I filtered the group posts down to three rooms for rent near the metro.
examples.zh: 我把群里的帖子筛了筛，留下三套地铁附近的「房屋出租」。

words.enDefinition: a post announcing an open room in a flat

examples.en: Her post says room available from October first, right by the engineering quad.
examples.zh: 她的帖子写着十月一日起「有房出租」，就在工学院广场旁边。

examples.en: Message quickly whenever you see room available in a quiet flat.
examples.zh: 一看到安静公寓里「有房出租」，就要马上联系。

collocations: room available in a shared flat

words.enDefinition: a large group of rental apartments in one place

examples.en: Our apartment complex has a laundry room and a study lounge downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们「公寓小区」楼下有洗衣房和自习休息室。

examples.en: The apartment complex office keeps spare keys and handles package lockers.
examples.zh: 「公寓小区」的管理处保管备用钥匙，也负责快递柜。

words.enDefinition: not enough rental homes for everyone looking

examples.en: The housing shortage near campus means even basements get five applicants.
examples.zh: 学校附近「房源紧张」，连地下室都有五个人抢。

examples.en: During the housing shortage, landlords pick their tenants within hours.
examples.zh: 「房源紧张」的时候，房东几个小时就能定下租客。

words.enDefinition: rental homes priced for people on small budgets

examples.en: The city's affordable housing list is long, so apply the moment you land.
examples.zh: 本市「可负担住房」的排队名单很长，一落地就要去申请。

examples.en: Graduate families often qualify for affordable housing near the medical school.
examples.zh: 研究生家庭常常符合医学院附近「可负担住房」的申请条件。

words.enDefinition: the person living in the unit right now

examples.en: I asked the current tenant whether the heating actually works in January.
examples.zh: 我问了「现任租客」，一月份暖气到底够不够热。

examples.en: The current tenant is moving out early, so the unit was still furnished at the viewing.
examples.zh: 「现任租客」要提前搬走，所以看房时家具还在。

collocations: ask the current tenant about the landlord

words.enDefinition: traffic and street sounds heard inside the flat

examples.en: Street noise on the second floor kept me awake until the bar closed.
examples.zh: 二楼临街，「街道噪音」吵到酒吧打烊才停。

examples.en: Visit after nine to judge the street noise for yourself.
examples.zh: 九点以后再去看房，亲自感受一下「街道噪音」。

words.enDefinition: close enough to reach on foot comfortably

examples.en: The flat is within walking distance of campus, the gym, and an Asian market.
examples.zh: 这套公寓到学校、健身房和亚洲超市都在「步行距离」内。

examples.en: Rent drops fast once you go beyond walking distance from the main gate.
examples.zh: 一旦超出主校门的「步行距离」，房租掉得飞快。

words.enDefinition: the minimum earnings a landlord expects from tenants

examples.en: The income requirement is three times the monthly rent before tax.
examples.zh: 「收入要求」是月房租的三倍，且按税前算。

examples.en: Most students cannot meet the income requirement alone, so add a guarantor.
examples.zh: 大多数学生单独达不到「收入要求」，所以要加担保人。

words.enDefinition: a prepared pack about you for landlord applications

examples.en: My renter profile includes ID, a reference letter, and my budget.
examples.zh: 我的「租客档案」包括证件、推荐信和预算。

examples.en: Send your renter profile within an hour of a promising listing.
examples.zh: 看到合适的房源，一小时内就把「租客档案」发过去。
